text:
ada: Quick flag: discovered stray PII in console inspect for sampled requests on our batching routes. Looks like emails and phone numbers surface if the sampling boundary is inconsistent. Need immediate policy decision.

omar: can you show a sanitized log snippet? is this only in the UI or shipped to telemetry sinks too?

ada: sanitized example below: 
```
req { route: "/v1/chat/completions", tenant: "tenant-42" }
sampled_log: { user_contact: "bob@tenant.com", prompt_snippet: "..." }
```
UI inspect reveals user_contact even though we believed sampled payloads should be redacted.

tina: yikes. We need a clear per-route redaction policy. My proposal: default sampled-data = pseudonymize (stable pseudonym), allow per-tenant opt-in to detailed audit blobs. Unpseudonymize/unmasking requires 2-person audit + token.

harry: stable pseudonymization helps anti-abuse dedup, but stable across tenants is bad. Use per-tenant pepper + kdf: pseudonym = base64(kdf(tenant_salt, value)). Rotation plan: rotate tenant_salt yearly and store old salts to unmask past blobs.

diane: backing-store question: where do we keep the raw PII for audit/unmask? we have to seal it in KMS-backed vaults and record an audit id in logs. No raw in day-to-day telemetry. Also retention must be configurable by tenant and surfaced in billing.

omar: operationally we already sample via sampler service. Two options: (A) sampler emits pointer + field with pseudonym, async job writes audit blob when configured; (B) sampler removes field entirely and we rely on request replay for audit. A is better for support.

ad a: I'm leaning A but with conservative defaults: for any tenant without explicit audit enabled => remove PII (no pseudonym). For tenants with audit enabled => pseudonym in sampled logs + sealed audit blob created.

tina: UX: console should show pseudonym in most flows and a clear "REQUESTED UNMASK" flow that logs actor, time, reason. Also show a red action button disabled unless user has "audit:unmask" scope.

harry: perf note: computing HMAC/KDF per-request adds cost. For high-QPS routes do pseudonymization as a fast HMAC-SHA256 using libfastcrypto and cache results for short TTL. We must throttle the cache memory.

ad a: fallback behavior if audit blob creation fails (storage throttle) => mark sample as "redacted-failed" and store only pseudonym if available, else mark removed. Admin dashboard needs counts of failures.

diane: legal: retention default 90d for audit blobs, explicit opt-in for longer. Also add a deletion webhook for tenant data deletion requests.

omar: metrics here: per-route columns: pct-sampled, pct-pseudonymized, avg-audit-blob-latency(s), audit-blobs-created-per-hour. We should add alert when avg-audit-blob-latency > 10s.

ada: rollout: feature-flagged canary -> 2% tenants (no enterprise-sla tenants), enable for read-only routes first. If stable, ramp to 20% then region-specific.

harry: storage cost: estimate per blob 2KB metadata + sealed payload ~1KB => 3KB per unmaskable sample. At 100k samples/day that is ~300MB/day. Billing/quotas need to account.

tina: quick security detail: unmask endpoint must require short-lived MFK token (just-in-time), record MFA actor. No raw values in logs or metrics.

ad a: draft action list: 1) default policy: remove unless tenant opts-in for audit. 2) opt-in creates pseudonym + audit blob. 3) pseudonym = per-tenant HMAC-SHA256(k=tenant_salt). 4) audit blob sealed in KMS and referenced by id. 5) console unmask requires audit token + logs audit record. 6) telemetry dashboard adds columns/alerts. 7) retention and billing hooks. 8) canary rollout plan.

diane: +1. I'll coordinate legal and data subject request hooks.

omar: I'll sketch sampler changes and async blob writer. Expected overhead: ~1.8% CPU for control plane during canary.

harry: I'll PR fastcrypto binding + cache.

tina: I'll mock console states and disabled button UX.

platform-bot: deploy: scheduled canary of sampler-pseudonymize v1 to eng-platform on 2024-09-01T01:30:00Z (auto).

ad a: OK I'll write an RFC tonight with sequence diagrams and the per-tenant opt-in flow. Will include storage and billing estimate. Please +1 if no objections.

harry: +1

diane: +1 (pending legal review)

omar: +1

tina: +1

ad a: thanks all, I'll open RFC and a quick POC branch.
